UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, filter tabs, modal triggers).
Use Barlow Condensed font for headlines and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text.
Never use generic centered layouts or light backgrounds. The palette must remain pitch black (#05070D) and electric blue (#2F6BFF).
Ensure header backdrop is bg-[#05070D]/85 backdrop-blur-md z-50 to prevent content overlap readability issues.
GDPR banner buttons (Accept / Reject / Customize) MUST have equal visual prominence.
All form inputs must be fully functional with visual feedback and Sonner toasts.
